anomalies.observed: The GPIO_B link between the NAVC and FCC is a 10 pF capacitor (C72, value 10p, footprint C_0402) rather than a series resistor. Every other GPIO link (GPIO_A, C, D, E, F, G, H) uses a 10 Ω series resistor (R40, R42-R47). The reference R41 is absent from the netlist, which suggests the series resistor position was filled by a capacitor.
anomalies.expected: A series 10 Ω resistor between GPIO_B_NAVC and GPIO_B_FCC, matching the other GPIO links, so that the signal path is resistive and not capacitively coupled to ground or the other side.
anomalies.impact: The GPIO_B line is a series capacitor, so it passes only AC and has no DC path between the two MCUs. The 10 pF capacitor also gives the line a different edge and filtering behaviour from the other GPIOs, so the inter-MCU GPIO_B signal will not work as intended.
